top_signals.title: Evergrande Liquidators Plan First Payout to Creditors Next Year
top_signals.summary: Nearly three years after China Evergrande Group began winding up, liquidators have recovered less than 1% of the $46 billion sought by creditors, which they aim to begin distributing in the first half of 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Spain’s Seaya Enters London After Raising €600 Million
top_signals.summary: Seaya, a Spanish venture capital firm backed by Banco Santander SA, is opening an office in London after raising €600 million ($637 million) for a new fund focused on European startups.

top_signals.title: Jio Leverage Play Pops Up at SBI as India Brokers Lure IPO Bets
top_signals.summary: In a rare move for an Indian initial public offering, SBI Securities is offering a leveraged bet on the deal of Jio Platforms Ltd. — a sign of the intense competition among brokerages as the excitement over the debut is building to a fever pitch.
